note: Eritel service page for a domestically hosted private cloud; states nothing about a rule on sending data abroad.
AfCFTA resource page; says only that Eritrea has not signed the agreement, nothing on a national rule on sending data abroad.
IGAD project page on regional data flows; lists seven member states without Eritrea and states no Eritrean rule on sending data abroad.
AML/CFT mutual evaluation excerpt; states nothing on a rule on sending data abroad.

facts.fact: The UNECA digital trade profile states that no legal regime in Eritrea deals with the general flow of data and that no conditions are made for the flow of data; the document gives no date for the statement, so its published date of 2022-01-01 is used.
Levellers, in a legal-status page last reviewed 8 June 2026, states that Eritrea has no data protection legislation and no restriction on cross-border transfer of data in its law.

note: One fact: dated statement that no rule restricts cross-border transfer; nothing on means of complying or application.
